SRC046.limitations: Counts court/tribunal decisions addressing hallucinated content; maintainer states it does not track the wider universe of fake citations; inclusion involves judgment calls; counts read via a fetch tool summarizing filter counts and may lag. | Only the landing page and its filter counts were read; individual entries not audited. Compiler-curated (inclusion is a 'judgment call'); covers only decisions addressing hallucinations, not the universe of AI-assisted filings, so no rate/denominator. Counts change over time. [R2C-17] Counts read through a fetch tool; access set to partial.

SRC038.limitations: 127 upper-level law students; hallucination counts very small; WS4 read full text (law.berkeley.edu copy), WS3 abstract only (R2C-05/R2C-17).

SRC017.limitations: Working paper version (peer-review status of this version not established; source_type closest category). Single hypothetical case (insurance claim reserve); 98 audit managers; DV is proposed adjustment (reliance), no ground-truth accuracy measure; time-on-task result marginal (one-tailed p=0.09). [R2C-22] Same research program as SRC105; distinct experiment.

SRC105.limitations: Abstract only (UNLV repository landing page); participant count, experience level, effect sizes and design details not reviewed. Experimental case, not field audits. [R2C-22] Same research program as SRC017; distinct experiment.

EVR144.limitations: Single designed outside-frontier task with a known right answer; producers, not recipients, were studied. [R2C-01] Outside-frontier task was deliberately designed so that GPT-4 would give a plausible but wrong answer; the inside-frontier arm of the same experiment showed gains (see the coordinator-added item from the same source).

EVR186.transferability_to_target_workflow: Strongest mechanism-level support found for P2.1/P2.2: what matters is whether the presentation makes checking cheaper than re-deriving. Diligence analogue: a pinpoint link from an advisor's claim to the exact contract clause/data series (cheap check) vs a narrative justification (costly check). Must be tested in realistic documents where checking a source still requires judgment. [R2C-16] Plausible mechanism analog only (crowdworker maze task); needs verification with accountable professionals reviewing advisor reports.

EVR122.limitations: Vendor-run survey summarized in a blog; inconsistent N; recall-based time estimates; counterfactual 'sender doing the work' is the recipient's guess; HBR article body not accessed. [R2C-03] Self-reported estimates; convenience survey; vendor-affiliated research.

EVR065.quantitative_result: Superseded by EVR114 (full text read by WS4); figures in this abstract-level item were unverified.

EVR059.observed_finding: DOE OIG found the Loan Programs Office contracts third-party advisors for financial/credit, engineering/technical and market reports and relies on their work as essential components of the loan application process while prospective borrowers pay; a limited pool of qualified firms means some advisors also work for applicants; for 18 projects reviewed, LPO could identify the engineering advisors for only 3 and the marketing/financial advisors for none; reliance on advisors' self-identification of conflicts 'creates a blind spot'. [R2C-06 clarification] For the 18 projects reviewed, LPO could identify the engineering third-party advisors working for prospective borrowers on only 3, and marketing/financial borrower-side advisors on none, so it could not check whether individuals supporting LPO also worked for applicants.
coordinator_corrections: R2C-06: relationship corrected to supports (relative to its P-NEW); borrower-side wording added

EVR116.analyst_inference: [Rewritten per R2C-07] Survey self-reports from chatbot users (not recipients) indicate that new tasks include oversight/QA of AI output; the category also includes detecting others' AI use (e.g., teachers). Shows the existence and share of reported new tasks, not measured review hours or net workload.

EVR118.transferability_to_target_workflow: Close task analog: financial outputs drafted by AI require accuracy/completeness review by the accountable professional, analogous to analysts reviewing AI-drafted model outputs or memo sections. [R2C-07/R2C-16] Self-reported new tasks among AI users; not measured review hours of recipients of outside analysis.

EVR141.limitations: Developers act as both producer and reviewer of AI output; small N; high-quality-standard repositories with extensive implicit context; tools of early 2025. [R2C-08] Producer-side AI use by experts in their own repositories, not receipt of outside analysis; slowdown is multi-causal per the authors; CI shown in a figure, not extracted.

EVR209.observed_finding: Johns Hopkins requires second-opinion review of outside surgical pathology before treating referred patients; over 21 months, 86 of 6,171 reviewed cases (1.4%) had a changed diagnosis causing major modification in therapy or prognosis, with higher rates for serosal surfaces (9.5%) and female reproductive tract (5.1%). The authors note the practice was threatened by managed-care cost containment and recommend review before major therapy. [R2C-09] Yield denominator = all referred cases; low per-case yield, high per-error consequence.
coordinator_corrections: R2C-09: relabelled qualifies for P1.3 (continues to support P1.1 policy-driven review)

EVR210.observed_finding: University of Iowa requires second opinion of outside surgical pathology slides before definitive treatment; of 5,629 cases, 132 (2.3%) had major and 507 (9.0%) minor diagnostic disagreements; 68 (1.2% of all cases) led to changes in clinical management on follow-up. [R2C-09] Yield denominator = all referred cases; low per-case yield, high per-error consequence.
coordinator_corrections: R2C-09: relabelled qualifies for P1.3 (continues to support P1.1 policy-driven review)

EVR010.limitations: Confounded by COVID and other rule changes (staff explicitly say not causal). [R2C-15] Staff note that the +2.3 pp planning-phase shift is consistent with a broader shift of total audit hours to earlier phases, i.e., not attributable to the new requirements.

EVR039.transferability_to_target_workflow: Directly transferable principle for lenders using IE/market/insurance advisors: analysis may be outsourced; the decision and the vetting of the advisor's independence/qualifications may not. [R2C-16] Plausible mechanism analog, not 'directly transferable': US bank investment-securities rule; needs verification against renewable-energy lender/IC policies.

EVR045.transferability_to_target_workflow: Core mechanism transfers directly: credit receivers re-cut IE output into their own cases rather than adopting the IE's base case. What transfers to an advisor product is the need to supply exceedance distributions (P50/P90/P99, one-year vs ten-year) and adjustable inputs so the receiver can apply its own criteria without reconstruction. [R2C-16] Rests on 2012 Fitch presentation slides; current criteria not retrieved; plausible mechanism analog requiring verification against current rating criteria and lender practice.

EVR069.transferability_to_target_workflow: Strong structural analog: producer (responding party/vendor) -> receiving professional (opposing counsel/court) -> decision. Acceptance rests on disclosed process, sampling of what was excluded (checks with no findings), and opportunity to challenge. For diligence: disclose what was reviewed, how, and a sample of what was screened out. [R2C-16] Differences: high-volume document classification with statistical validation and an adversary; diligence judgments are low-volume and bespoke. Needs verification that recipients would accept coverage evidence in place of item review.

EVR084.transferability_to_target_workflow: Closest regulatory analog to the thesis: the buyer accepts outside work using the supplier's documented evidence and periodic audits of the supplier's process, graded by importance. Diligence analog: lenders accepting IE work based on IE qualification and documented scope rather than redoing it. [R2C-16] Differences: nuclear QA regulation; needs verification of analogous grading in diligence.

EVR086.transferability_to_target_workflow: Directly supports curated evidence linkage (key assumptions flagged, criteria agreed upfront, interpretive summaries with worked examples) over data dumps. Energy diligence analog: agreeing the IC's acceptance criteria (Basis of Design) with the advisor before work starts. [R2C-16] Guideline prescribes curated linkage; it does not show that curation reduces reviewer effort.

EVR134.transferability_to_target_workflow: Accountable professional buyer adopted while explicitly retaining professional review; analogous to investors adopting diligence tools while retaining analyst/IC review. [R2C-16] Firm announcement; shows retained review policy, not effort.

EVR046.limitations: Single asset; read via fetch tool with truncated quotes; no mention of the independent engineer. [R2C-18] Not re-verifiable in Round 2 (blocked); figures come from a fetch-tool summary of a secondary republication; treat as unverified secondary figures, not headline numbers.

EVR047.limitations: Secondary report, read via fetch tool; does not identify whether P50s came from lender IEs or sponsor consultants; vendor-produced dataset. [R2C-18] Not re-verifiable in Round 2 (blocked); figures come from a fetch-tool summary of a secondary republication; treat as unverified secondary figures, not headline numbers.

EVR213.limitations: Same as above; the decision to import may correlate with other workflow factors. [R2C-19] Outcome is repeat imaging, not end-to-end work; observational, confounding by indication possible (images not imported may have been inadequate); import effort not measured.

EVR162.observed_finding: At Senate Estimates, the DEWR Secretary said the department should not receive work with glaring errors in footnotes and sources and that her staff should not be double-checking a third-party provider's footnotes; the Minister said departmental processes are expected to ensure consultants' work is high quality. Officials reported recovering $97,587 of the fee. [R2C-21] Finance officials said the errors were discovered only through media reporting (as reported by Region Canberra; Hansard not verified).

EVR033.limitations: No ground truth for correct adjustment, so effects are on reliance, not accuracy; single case; working paper; CAQ funded. [R2C-22] Same research program as EVR191; distinct experiment.

EVR191.limitations: Abstract only; no ground truth for 'correct' adjustment stated in abstract; hypothetical case. [R2C-22] Same research program as EVR033; distinct experiment.

EVR020.analyst_inference: Direct standard-level link: absence of a description of checks performed (X4) forces additional receiver work — the cleanest public example of W2 caused by missing coverage information. [R2C-25] Standards require additional procedures when producer documentation is missing (obligation); whether this produces measurable extra work, or instead shallower review, is not observed in these sources.

EVR003.analyst_inference: Standard-level recognition that producer documentation of method can substitute for receiver reconstruction (alternative model) — the closest public-standard analog to P1.2/P2.1. When descriptions are absent, the fallback is building an alternative model: W2 reconstruction caused by opacity. [R2C-25] Standards require additional procedures when producer documentation is missing (obligation); whether this produces measurable extra work, or instead shallower review, is not observed in these sources.

EVR018.analyst_inference: Documentation of procedures and findings is a gating condition for any reliance: without it the receiver must do the work itself (W2). With it, the receiver still evaluates and re-performs some (W1). The standard thus separates W1 and W2 cleanly. [R2C-25] Standards require additional procedures when producer documentation is missing (obligation); whether this produces measurable extra work, or instead shallower review, is not observed in these sources.
